newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Foreign investment in Shenzhen reaches $10.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Shenzhen reaches $10.8 bln.

text.p: Accumulated actual foreign investment in Shenzhen reached US$10.8 billion by end-September, with US$1.398 billion in the first three quarters of 1996, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
Of actual investment in the January-September period, 72.7 percent went into the industrial sector, with 41 projects receiving more than US$5 million each and 21 more than US$10 million, it said.
Contracted foreign investment in the nine-month period was US$1.376 billion, it said.
The paper said that the investment reflected foreign investor confidence in the southern China city next to Hong Kong due to return to Beijing in mid-1997.
